introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy describes how TinyCompressor collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our image compression and conversion services.

informationCollection.title: Information We Collect
informationCollection.content: We do not collect, store, or transmit your images. All processing happens locally in your browser.

dataProcessing.title: Data Processing
dataProcessing.content: All image processing is performed entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use cookies only to remember your language preference and improve your experience.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
